allow: PowerShell($file = "C:\\tmp\\.env.netlify-prod"; Write-Host "File exists: $\(Test-Path $file\)"; Write-Host "File size: $\(\(Get-Item $file\).Length\) bytes"; Write-Host "Total lines: $\(\(Get-Content $file\).Count\)"; Write-Host ""; Write-Host "Lines starting with MAIL_FROM_NAME or INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD:"; Get-Content $file -Encoding UTF8 | Select-String -Pattern '^\(MAIL_FROM_NAME|INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD\)' | ForEach-Object { $line = $_.Line; $eqIdx = $line.IndexOf\('='\); $key = $line.Substring\(0, $eqIdx\); $val = $line.Substring\($eqIdx + 1\); $len = $val.Length; Write-Host "  $key= \(value length: $len\)" })
